caseNameFull: Motors Insurance Corp. v. Robinson, Superintendent of Insurance
attorneys: J. Rath Crabbe and Clarence D. Laylin for appellants., C. William O’Neill, Attorney General of Ohio, Robert E. Leach, Chief Counsel, and Ralph Klapp and Don W. Montgomery, Assistant Attorneys General, for appellees.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam:

The motion to dismiss is granted and the appeal is dismissed for the want of a substantial federal question.
